environment.src_tree_sha256_method: sha256 of the concatenated contents of every regular file under julia/PeggleSim/src, files sorted by relative path; src_jl_sha256 applies the same method to *.jl files only

method: Base.gc_bytes() deltas around one measured region; GC.gc() and any reset/launch preparation run outside the region, never inside it. The engine is warmed with full shots at the measured aim and trace is disabled (eng.trace = nothing); summary callbacks only, no snapshots, result extraction, JSONL writing, or tracing inside any measured region. reset is reset_shot_engine!(eng, ckpt) only. launch is launch!(eng, aim) after a reset outside the region (staged launch events are flushed by the first steady-state step). run is run_shot!(eng; max_steps=step_cap) after reset+launch outside the region. steady_state is update!(eng, config.fixed_dt) per step in the same loop shape as run_shot! (save_previous_state!, step_simulation!/finalize_step!, fever bucket update, steps_run bookkeeping) until shot_done or the step cap, starting from a fresh reset and recording step 1. Sites come from Profile.Allocs at sample_rate=1.0 over a separate warmed run of the same steady-state loop, aggregated by the first stack frame whose file is under julia/PeggleSim/src. Measured single-threaded (nthreads=1).
notes: Phases are measured in a separate process pass each; allocation bytes are deterministic for a fixed tree.
Profile.Allocs sizes are payload sizes and exclude GC headers/padding; site bytes_per_step therefore do not sum to the measured steady_state total (see each workload's profile ratios).
The zero-allocation verdict is the orchestrator's; this file only reports the per-phase pass flags for the stated criterion.

launch.includes: launch!(eng, aim) after a reset outside the region
launch.note: m4-perf section 1.4: launch is per-shot overhead, not the stepping gate; staged launch events are flushed by the first steady_state step

reset.includes: reset_shot_engine!(eng, ckpt) only; GC.gc() before the region
reset.note: m4-perf section 1.3: reset is per-shot overhead, not the zero-allocation stepping gate; budget 0 is the near-zero target

run.note: whole-shot context; not part of the steady-state gate

steady_state.criterion: m4-perf section 1.1: sum(Base.gc_bytes() deltas) == 0 AND max single-step delta == 0 over a warmed pass starting from a fresh reset
steady_state.includes: per-step update!(eng, config.fixed_dt): save_previous_state!, step_simulation!/finalize_step! (including the fever bucket update), and steps_run bookkeeping; loop condition identical to run_shot!

profile.classification_basis: sites are measured in the full steady-state pass at the same shot index as the measured pass; a site absent from a second pass on the same engine is classified one_time_capacity_growth, because it does not recur after the container has grown; checkpoint.jl/restore frames are reset and trace/snapshot/canonical/jsonio frames are export_only; everything else is in_scope_steady_state
profile.coverage_note: Profile.Allocs records payload sizes; Base.gc_bytes() also counts GC object headers and padding, so profiled bytes are expected to be below the measured total. A nonzero measured_pass_delta_bytes also means the separate profiled pass allocated differently from the clean measured pass; that delta is not attributed to any site. Ratios are reported, not corrected.

repeat_pass.description: second steady-state pass on the same engine immediately after the full pass; used only to separate one-time growth from per-step sites
